title: AWS RDS (terraform-aws-modules/rds/aws)
description: Provision an RDS database (DB subnet group, DB instance and optional DB parameter group) via ACK rds. Input names mirror the terraform-aws-modules/rds/aws module (core subset of its inputs).

region.title: AWS region
region.description: AWS region for the RDS resources. Krateo/ACK wiring (not a Terraform module input). Empty inherits the ACK controller default.

identifier.title: identifier
identifier.description: The name of the RDS instance.

instance_class.title: instance_class
instance_class.description: The instance type of the RDS instance.

max_allocated_storage.title: max_allocated_storage
max_allocated_storage.description: Specifies the value for Storage Autoscaling.

storage_type.title: storage_type
storage_type.description: One of 'standard' (magnetic), 'gp2' (general purpose SSD), 'gp3' (new generation of general purpose SSD), or 'io1' (provisioned IOPS SSD).

iops.title: iops
iops.description: The amount of provisioned IOPS. Setting this implies a storage_type of 'io1' or 'gp3'.

storage_throughput.title: storage_throughput
storage_throughput.description: Storage throughput value for the DB instance. Only applies to the gp3 storage type.

storage_encrypted.title: storage_encrypted
storage_encrypted.description: Specifies whether the DB instance is encrypted.

kms_key_id.title: kms_key_id
kms_key_id.description: The ARN for the KMS encryption key. If creating an encrypted replica, set this to the destination KMS ARN.

db_name.title: db_name
db_name.description: The DB name to create. If omitted, no database is created initially.

username.title: username
username.description: Username for the master DB user.

manage_master_user_password.title: manage_master_user_password
manage_master_user_password.description: Set to true to allow RDS to manage the master user password in Secrets Manager. When true, master_user_password_secret is ignored.

master_user_password_secret.title: master_user_password_secret
master_user_password_secret.description: Krateo/ACK wiring for the master password (the TF module accepts a literal `password`; ACK requires a SecretKeyRef). When manage_master_user_password is false, this references a Kubernetes Secret holding the master user password.

name.description: Name of the Kubernetes Secret containing the master user password.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Secret. Defaults to the Composition namespace when empty.

key.description: Key within the Secret that holds the password.

port.title: port
port.description: The port on which the DB accepts connections.

multi_az.title: multi_az
multi_az.description: Specifies if the RDS instance is multi-AZ.

availability_zone.title: availability_zone
availability_zone.description: The Availability Zone of the RDS instance.

publicly_accessible.title: publicly_accessible
publicly_accessible.description: Bool to control if instance is publicly accessible.

subnet_ids.title: subnet_ids
subnet_ids.description: A list of VPC subnet IDs. Used to create the DB subnet group this instance is placed in.

vpc_security_group_ids.title: vpc_security_group_ids
vpc_security_group_ids.description: List of VPC security groups to associate.

network_type.title: network_type
network_type.description: The type of network stack to use. Valid values: IPV4 | DUAL.

backup_retention_period.title: backup_retention_period
backup_retention_period.description: The days to retain backups for.

backup_window.title: backup_window
backup_window.description: The daily time range (in UTC) during which automated backups are created if they are enabled.

maintenance_window.title: maintenance_window
maintenance_window.description: The window to perform maintenance in. Syntax: 'ddd:hh24:mi-ddd:hh24:mi'. Eg: 'Mon:00:00-Mon:03:00'.

copy_tags_to_snapshot.title: copy_tags_to_snapshot
copy_tags_to_snapshot.description: On delete, copy all Instance tags to the final snapshot.

deletion_protection.title: deletion_protection
deletion_protection.description: The database can't be deleted when this value is set to true.

auto_minor_version_upgrade.title: auto_minor_version_upgrade
auto_minor_version_upgrade.description: Indicates that minor engine upgrades will be applied automatically to the DB instance during the maintenance window.

iam_database_authentication_enabled.title: iam_database_authentication_enabled
iam_database_authentication_enabled.description: Specifies whether mappings of AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) accounts to database accounts is enabled.

performance_insights_enabled.title: performance_insights_enabled
performance_insights_enabled.description: Specifies whether Performance Insights are enabled.

enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports.title: enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports
enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports.description: List of log types to enable for exporting to CloudWatch logs. If omitted, no logs will be exported.

license_model.title: license_model
license_model.description: License model information for this DB instance. Optional, but required for some DB engines.

ca_cert_identifier.title: ca_cert_identifier
ca_cert_identifier.description: Specifies the identifier of the CA certificate for the DB instance.

monitoring_interval.title: monitoring_interval
monitoring_interval.description: The interval, in seconds, between points when Enhanced Monitoring metrics are collected for the instance. Set to 0 to disable.

monitoring_role_arn.title: monitoring_role_arn
monitoring_role_arn.description: The ARN for the IAM role that permits RDS to send enhanced monitoring metrics to CloudWatch Logs.

create_db_subnet_group.title: create_db_subnet_group
create_db_subnet_group.description: Whether to create a database subnet group from subnet_ids.

db_subnet_group_name.title: db_subnet_group_name
db_subnet_group_name.description: Name of DB subnet group. The DB instance will be created in the VPC associated with the DB subnet group. When create_db_subnet_group is false, this must reference an existing subnet group.

db_subnet_group_description.title: db_subnet_group_description
db_subnet_group_description.description: Description of the DB subnet group to create.

create_db_parameter_group.title: create_db_parameter_group
create_db_parameter_group.description: Whether to create a database parameter group.

parameter_group_name.title: parameter_group_name
parameter_group_name.description: Name of the DB parameter group to associate or create. When create_db_parameter_group is false, this must reference an existing parameter group.

parameter_group_description.title: parameter_group_description
parameter_group_description.description: Description of the DB parameter group to create.

family.title: family
family.description: The family of the DB parameter group (e.g. mysql8.0, postgres16). Required when create_db_parameter_group is true.

parameters.title: parameters
parameters.description: A map of DB parameters to apply to the created DB parameter group (parameter name -> value). The TF module accepts a list of objects; here it is expressed as a map(string) matching the ACK parameterOverrides field.

tags.title: tags
tags.description: A mapping of tags to assign to all resources.

db_instance_tags.title: db_instance_tags
db_instance_tags.description: Additional tags for the DB instance.

db_subnet_group_tags.title: db_subnet_group_tags
db_subnet_group_tags.description: Additional tags for the DB subnet group.

db_parameter_group_tags.title: db_parameter_group_tags
db_parameter_group_tags.description: Additional tags for the DB parameter group.
